known_limitations: These parameters are an approximate rendering prior, not a measured GoPro or RealSense calibration.
Lens distortion and per-frame HyperSmooth crop or warp are not modeled.
Image-space alignment adjusts rendered arm layers without changing input joint angles.
description: Shared approximate virtual camera for initial G1 projection. Image-derived cuff locations and arm masks refine the projected arms in 2D.
